messages.subject: Set_source not updating the source
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to have an arrival in a trajectory activate the generator for another trajectory. In the below example, this means that an arrival in the "yes_cvman" trajectory activates the "tamp" trajectory. I couldn't make it work using the activate activity so I am trying to use a combination of set_trajectory and set_source with the idea being that the generator for the "tamp" trajectory starts assigned to the "cvman" trajectory and has an interarrival distribution far higher than the simulation run time. Set_trajectory and _set source would be used to update this once there is an arrival to the "yes_cvman" trajectory.

My issue is that set_trajectory does work but the set_source activity does not change the interarrival times.

See below for an shortened example:

env <- simmer()

cvman <- trajectory("cvman") %>% 
  
  branch(function() sample(c(1,2), size=1, replace=T, prob = c(0.9,0.1)), continue=c(T),
         trajectory("no_cvman") %>%
           seize("no_cvman_dummy", 1) %>%
           timeout(1),
         trajectory("yes_cvman") %>%
           seize("cvman_dummy", 1) %>%
           branch(function() sample(c(1,2), size=1, replace=T, prob = c((1-prob_peri),prob_peri)), continue=c(T),
                  trajectory("no_pericarditis") %>%
                    seize("no_peri_dummy", 1) %>%
                    timeout(task = 1),
                  trajectory("pericarditis") %>%
                    seize("peri_dummy", 1) %>%
                    seize("periec", 1) %>%
                    seize("perieq", 1) %>%
                    set_attribute("attb_peri", 1) %>%
                    timeout(flare_length) %>%
                    seize("periogc", 1) %>%
                    seize("periogq", 1) %>%                            
                    set_source("tamp_patient", function () 100) %>%
                    set_trajectory("tamp_patient", tamp)
           )         
  )

#Tamponade event
tamp <- trajectory("tamponade") %>%
  branch(function() sample(c(1,2),size=1,replace=T,prob = c(prob_tamp,(1-prob_tamp))), continue=c(F),
         trajectory("no_tamp") %>%
           leave(prob = 1),
         trajectory("tamp") %>%
           seize("tamp_dummy", 1) %>%
           seize("tampc", 1) %>%
           seize("tampq", 1) %>%
           timeout(tamp_length)
  )


env %>%
  
  add_resource("no_cvman_dummy", Inf) %>%
  add_resource("cvman_dummy", Inf) %>%
  add_resource("no_peri_dummy", Inf) %>%
  add_resource("periec", Inf) %>%
  add_resource("perieq", Inf) %>%
  add_resource("periogc", Inf) %>%
  add_resource("periogq", Inf) %>%
  add_resource("peri_dummy", Inf) %>%
  add_resource("tampc", Inf) %>%
  add_resource("tampq", Inf) %>%
  add_resource("tamp_dummy", Inf) %>%
  
  add_generator("cvman_patient", cvman, function() time_to_flare, mon = 2) %>%
  add_generator("tamp_patient", cvman, distribution = function() 1000000, mon = 2) %>%
  
  run(2000)

get_mon_arrivals(env)
get_mon_resources(env)

Is there something that I am missing?

Many thanks in advance,
Tray

parts:
El mié., 20 jun. 2018 a las 12:53, Tray Brown (<vrbro...@gmail.com>) escribió:
>
> Hi,
>
> I am trying to have an arrival in a trajectory activate the generator for another trajectory. In the below example, this means that an arrival in the "yes_cvman" trajectory activates the "tamp" trajectory. I couldn't make it work using the activate activity so I am trying to use a combination of set_trajectory and set_source with the idea being that the generator for the "tamp" trajectory starts assigned to the "cvman" trajectory and has an interarrival distribution far higher than the simulation run time. Set_trajectory and _set source would be used to update this once there is an arrival to the "yes_cvman" trajectory.
>
> My issue is that set_trajectory does work but the set_source activity does not change the interarrival times.

set_source does change interarrival times. What happens is that your
generator is initialised at 0 and schedules one arrival with a delay
equal to 1000000. It means that the generator won't run again (with
the new interarrival time) until t=1000000. So if you run until=2000,
you can't see your generator change.

Iñaki

parts:
Thanks for getting back so quickly Iñaki.

I understand the issue and, if I understand correctly, there is no way to change the interarrival time prior to the first generated arrival.

It sounds to me like I have to try a different solution. Originally I wanted to use an activate activity in the "yes_cvman" trajectory, so something like this:
trajectory("yes_cvman") %>%
branch(function() sample(c(1,2), size=1, replace=T, prob = c(prob_peri,(1-prob_peri))), continue=c(F),
trajectory("no_pericarditis") %>%

timeout(task = 1),
                   trajectory("pericarditis") %>%

seize("periec", 1) %>%
                     seize("perieq", 1) %>%
                     seize("peri_dummy", 1) %>%
                     set_attribute("attb_peri", 1) %>%
timeout_from_attribute("flare_length") %>%

seize("periogc", 1) %>%
                     seize("periogq", 1) %>%

activate("tamp")
                   )

tamp <- trajectory("tamponade") %>%
      branch(function() sample(c(1,2),size=1,replace=T,prob = c(prob_tamp,(1-prob_tamp))), continue=c(F),
    trajectory("no_tamp") %>%
      leave(prob = 1),
    trajectory("tamp") %>%
      seize("tamp_dummy", 1) %>%
      seize("tampc", 1) %>%
      seize("tampq", 1) %>%
      timeout(tamp_length)
      )

add_generator("cvman_patient", cvman, function() 50, mon = 2) %>%
      add_generator("tamp_patient", tamp, function() 100, mon = 2) %>%

      run(2000)

But I get an "Error in run_(private$sim_obj, until) : source 'tamp' not found (typo?)" error, which as far as I can tell is because I can't activate a generator that is attached to a trajectory different from the one that contains the activate activity. I also couldn't find a way to start the simulation with the tamp generator deactivated.

Are there ways around these issues that you are aware of, or do I need to go back to the drawing board?

My apologies if this is basic stuff.

Many thanks,
Tray
